about_desc1: French developer passionate about technology and innovation. Self-employed since 2022, Master's student in Physiological Engineering, Biotechnology and Computer Science at the University of Poitiers.
about_desc2: My journey in software engineering began during my university years, where I acquired a solid foundation in computer science. Since then, I have worked on various projects, mainly in small startups.
about_desc3: I believe in writing clean and maintainable code, and I am constantly learning new technologies to stay at the forefront of this ever-evolving field.
projects_desc: Here are the projects I have worked on that required the most time. They reflect my skills and passion for web development.
HPmat_desc: HPMat is a database for researchers in theoretical quantum chemistry, where you can consult, visualize, and download data. It is a full-stack application built with React for the front-end, Node.js for the REST API, and MySQL for the database.
Lydae_desc: Lydae Shop is a complete e-commerce site designed for a textile company, including a user front-end, a dedicated REST API, and a MongoDB database. It integrates a functional payment system via Stripe.
House24_desc: House 24 is a showcase site designed for a catering company. It offers a reservation mechanism and, above all, a 3D rendering on the homepage created with Three.js.
Dearbot_desc: DearBot is a Python bot developed for a resale Discord server. It is built with BeautifulSoup 4 and Discord.js and includes a Cloudflare bypass. Connected to the Vinted API, it allows for faster retrieval of items.
Basalt_desc: Basalt COD is a showcase site designed for a video game development company, created for the launch of this mobile game. It features dynamic animations, created with SVGator and GSAP, specifically for horizontal scrolling.
contact_desc: I am always looking for new opportunities and exciting projects. If you want to discuss a collaboration, a project, or just exchange ideas, feel free to contact me.
